site.name: ridenow-mobile
site.summary: ridenow-mobile Fictional rideshare app "RideNow" iOS-style mobile fixture. UXBench fixture in the Mobile Micro-UI category. Layout - 390 × 844 phone frame with chrome bezel, notch, status bar, home indicator - Bottom 4-tab bar: Ride / Activity / Payment / Account (Activity routes to the receipt screen) - Edge-to-edge on actual mobile (≤460 px) Screens (full ride flow) | `data-screen` | Highlights |

run_plan.goal: Execute a comprehensive UX audit of the 'RideNow' mobile fixture, validating the end-to-end booking flow, tab navigation integrity, and responsive behavior across desktop and mobile viewports.
run_plan.summary: The exploration will begin by verifying the Home screen layout and saved location interactions. It will then proceed through the primary 'Ride' booking flow (select destination -> choose ride -> confirm), followed by validation of secondary tabs (Activity, Payment, Account). Finally, it will repeat critical path checks on a mobile viewport to ensure touch targets and layout adapt correctly.
assumptions: The application is a Single Page Application (SPA) where 'screens' are toggled via JavaScript rather than separate HTML files.
The 'Where to?' input accepts text entry or selection from the visible lists (Recent/Saved).
The bottom tab bar persists across all main screens.
risk_hotspots: Small tap targets on header icons (Hamburger menu, Notifications) which failed the 44px accessibility guideline in prescan.
The 'Choose your ride' screen transition logic.
Mobile viewport layout shifts (specifically the bottom tab bar overlapping content).

phases.title: Home Screen & Location Selection
phases.objective: Validate the initial state, header controls, and location selection mechanisms.
key_checks: Verify visibility of 'Recent Places' and 'Saved' lists.
Test interaction with 'Saved' location cards (e.g., click 'Home' or 'Halcyon Studio').
Check header icons (Menu ☰, Notification 🔔) for clickability despite small size warnings.
exit_criteria: Successfully triggered a destination selection or opened a location detail view.

phases.title: Primary Booking Flow (Ride Tab)
phases.objective: Execute the core user journey: Select Destination -> Choose Ride Type -> Confirm Booking.
key_checks: Enter a destination in the 'Where to?' input field.
Identify and interact with the 'Choose your ride' section (likely appears after destination entry).
Select a specific ride tier (e.g., Economy, Premium).
Locate and click the final confirmation button (e.g., 'Request Ride').
exit_criteria: Reached a 'Trip complete', 'Driver Assigned', or 'Rate your driver' state.

phases.title: Post-Trip & Activity Validation
phases.objective: Validate the post-booking states and the Activity tab functionality.
key_checks: If in 'Rate your driver' state, submit a rating.
Navigate to the 'Activity' tab via the bottom bar.
Verify the presence of a receipt or trip history list.
Check for any empty states if no history exists.

phases.title: Secondary Tabs (Payment & Account)
phases.objective: Explore adjacent features to ensure no dead ends or broken layouts exist in secondary flows.
key_checks: Navigate to the 'Payment' tab; verify payment method display or add-new-flow triggers.
Navigate to the 'Account' tab; check for profile settings or logout options.
Ensure the bottom tab bar remains accessible and visually consistent.
exit_criteria: Visited both Payment and Account screens without layout errors.

phases.title: Mobile Viewport Regression
phases.objective: Repeat critical checks on a mobile-sized viewport (≤460px width) to catch responsive issues.
key_checks: Resize viewport to mobile dimensions (e.g., iPhone SE/12 size).
Re-test the 'Where to?' input for keyboard overlap issues.
Verify bottom tab bar hit areas are sufficient on smaller screens.
Confirm header icons are still clickable despite prescan warnings.
exit_criteria: Completed one full booking flow simulation on mobile viewport.

coverage_targets.pages: Visit all logical screens (Home, Ride Selection, Activity, Payment, Account) within index.html.
coverage_targets.features: Exercise destination selection, ride tier choice, tab navigation, and rating submission.
coverage_targets.mobile: Full regression of the booking flow on mobile viewport.
